claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: BAY-11-7082 at 2.5 uM is expected to kill cells mainly through its well-documented off-target inhibition of the NLRP3 inflammasome and NF-kB-independent cytotoxic effects, with additional contribution from its known IKK/NF-kB pathway inhibition, producing a selective pattern rather than broad cytotoxicity.
